ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida (Vice Society successor) — AnyDesk silent-install for hands-on-keyboard persistence
ucs.description: Hunts the CISA AA23-319A hallmark where Rhysida operators sideload AnyDesk via cmd.exe/PowerShell using `--install` + `--silent` + `--set-password` to establish a persistent, attacker-controlled remote-access channel after the initial Cobalt Strike beacon. The combination of all three flags (especially `--set-password`) is specific to Rhysida's playbook and is uncommon in legitimate IT-managed AnyDesk rollouts (which use MSI + group policy).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="AnyDesk.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="AnyDesk.exe") (Processes.process="*--install*" OR Processes.process="*--silent*" OR Processes.process="*--set-password*" OR Processes.process="*--start-with-win*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") AND NOT match(parent,"(?i)(msiexec|setup)\.exe") | rename firstTime as first_seen lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida AnyDesk silent-install + auto-start persistence (CISA AA23-319A)
let AnyDeskFlags = dynamic(["--install","--silent","--set-password","--start-with-win","--get-id"]);
let Install = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "AnyDesk.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "AnyDesk.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (AnyDeskFlags) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (AnyDeskFlags)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","intunemanagementextension.exe")  // strip enterprise pkg deploy
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildFile = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPath = FolderPath, SHA256;
// Pivot to confirm the password-set + service-install pair that Rhysida operators use back-to-back
Install
| summarize FlagsSeen = make_set(ChildCmd), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            ParentChain = make_set(Parent)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| where array_length(FlagsSeen) >= 1
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Rhysida AnyDesk silent-install persistence — ASIM cross-vendor
let AnyDeskFlags = dynamic(["--install","--silent","--set-password","--start-with-win","--get-id"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where TargetProcessName has "anydesk.exe"
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (AnyDeskFlags)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName !has_any ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","intunemanagementextension.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine
| summarize FlagsSeen = make_set(TargetProcessCommandLine), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername
| order by LastSeen desc

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17

  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida — ntdsutil IFM snapshot for offline NTDS.dit extraction
ucs.description: Hunts the `ntdsutil "ac i ntds" "ifm" "create full <path>"` command chain Rhysida operators run on a domain controller to dump a full NTDS.dit + SYSTEM hive copy for offline credential extraction. This precedes lateral movement via PsExec/SMB (T1021.002, T1569.002) and is consistently observed in Rhysida intrusions per CISA AA23-319A and Sophos X-Ops reporting on Rhysida (tracked alongside Vice Society's evolution).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where NOT match(parent,"(?i)(wbengine|ntbackup|veeam|backupexec)\.exe") | rename firstTime as first_seen lastTime as last_seen | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida ntdsutil IFM credential snapshot — pivot on parent + follow-on file writes
let NtdsCmd = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("wbengine.exe","ntbackup.exe","veeam.backup.shell.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
// Confirm with the NTDS.dit / SYSTEM hive copy that ntdsutil writes seconds later
let NtdsDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ ("ntds.dit","SYSTEM","SECURITY")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, FilePath = FolderPath, DroppedFile = FileName;
NtdsCmd
| join kind=leftouter NtdsDrops on DeviceId
| where isnull(FileTime) or FileTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          DroppedFile, FilePath, FileTime
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Rhysida ntdsutil IFM dump — Sentinel via SecurityEvent 4688
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds")
| where ParentProcessName !has_any ("wbengine.exe","ntbackup.exe","veeam.backup.shell.exe","backupexec")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
